Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This is my second Weber grill. My 10-year-old, 2-burner model finally gave up the ghost, but I had such good results with it that I wanted another one, just with three burners this time. Weber grills are simply the best.

Mine was already assembled and ready to go at Lowe's, but I spent some time making sure everything was screwed in correctly and tightly. No missing parts, and the grill fired up the first time. It heats to just above 550 degrees in aout 10 minutes with the burners on full blast; for searing steaks this is a must. But it handles low-and-slow cooking well, too, and I'm happy with its performance so far in all respects.

I purchased the (overpriced, but excellent) grill cover for it, as I want to keep it looking nice and protect it from the elements. I also plunked down for the iGrill probe that attaches to a magnetized pad on the grill and promises to mind your internal temperatures for you through a Bluetooth connection to your phone. That works okay, but it's not a game-changed for me, since I rarely stray too far from the grill while it's in use anyway.

The grates are cast-iron and you will need a good, soft-bristle brush to keep them clean, which you know already. But they release food beautifully if you apply a little cooking oil to them first, as you also should know to do.

Be good to your grill and it will be good to you. Buy a Weber, and it will be great to you.
Results.Title: The grill I wanted

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Purchased the Grill for my son who still lives with us. After the first use I noticed, while wiping the hood with a damp cloth, there were very dull spots on the paint and some tiny spots of bare metal were showing threw. I contacted Weber via telephone and sent them a couple pictures. I received a new hood in the mail within two days. I was amazed. The grill is fantastic as well. It heats up quickly, maintains heat. The flare ups are handled easily by the design. Can't really ask for anything more out of a gas grill. Also I was a little skeptical about the iron grates. But I have not had any trouble keeping them clean and rust is not an issue thus far. Thanks Weber for making a great product at a fair price.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This was actually the second weber that I purchased in the month of August.  The first was a Spirit 2 burner to replace a worn out grill at my vacation home.  Needless to say, I liked it so well that I didn't want to leave it there.  Soooo...I dug a little deeper into the pocket and bought a Spirit ll E-310 for my primary residence.  Now, at this point, you are saying "it's just a grill" right?  Wrong!  Now I know what all the hype is about in a Weber.  The model I bought is compact, sturdy ( I don't feel it is about to roll out from under me) and best of all, has a heating surface from edge to edge.  Other grills I've owned have had hot spots.  While they were much larger, there was only a portion of the of the heating surface that held the temperature I needed.  My job was to guess where it was.  Not so with my Weber.  The heat is consistent so I can cook as much on the not so large grates as I cooked on the larger grills. If you have an extremely large amount of cooking to do, there's a Weber for that!  Making the decision to purchase your Weber grill is the hardest thing about owning it.  The rest is easy!

Results.ReviewText: My older teo burner Spirit was at the end so we took the plunge and upsized to the three burner. It is almost the same footprint but much better cooking performance and larger grilling area. Nothing fancy. Just solid performance
Results.Title: Great performance in the perfect size

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After 5 years of cooking on a cheaper gas barbeque I can confirm the Weber is far superior.  The temperature is consistent across the grill, it stays hotter across the grill, sears the meat much better.  Cleans up easier than the cheaper barbecues.  The Spirit II E-310 LP is worth the extra expense.
Results.Title: Great Barbeque

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I switched grills because of the 10 year warranty.  I cooked hamburgers first and the grill worked great.  Small flare ups that quickly died down.  All burgers cooked evenly across the grill area.  Ready to try steaks next.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We purchased this about a month ago and went from a very large Vermont castings grill with rotisserie and all the bells and whistles to the spirit with just three burner functionality. I am finding it grills beautifully, and the size is perfect for our now family of two. I had the larger grill because we did a lot of entertaining in the past; we find that this smaller grill can handle large crowds as well as just the two of us and we are very happy with our purchase. We would recommend to anyone looking for a grill with performance and quality.
Results.Title: Perfectly sized grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The Spirit 3 burner is the perfect addition to my patio. Not only is it well suited for the cooking I do, the add on’s make it even better. Just added the Weber Porcelain griddle and it’s raised my grilling game. The 10 year parts warranty made the Weber purchase easy for me.
Results.Title: Perfect setup

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have been using Weber for 35 yrs,good quality grill
Results.Title: Great quality

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I love my grill, it is great. It heats up fast and stay true to the temperature that I set it at.
Results.Title: It heats up fast and cooks evenly, I love my grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: spectacular as i knew it would...the 20 year old genesis finally gave in to mother nature and just begged to be replaced. (winters in new england are known to be challenging to say the least)
Results.Title: performance at its best

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I last bought a Weber grill about 15 years ago and I’ve been cycling through products by different manufacturers for the last decade. This Weber Spirit reminded me of what I’ve been missing. It’s as solidly constructed as my first Weber, perhaps even more so. It gives me strong, even heat and it’s a pleasure to operate. I also appreciate the subtle evolutionary changes that have taken place over time. The grill and burner design is better than before and I like the improved ergonomic design and accessibility of the drain dish underneath. One thing that did take me off guard, though (and almost caused me to damage my brand new grill) is the innovative design of the lighter switch. My grill came pre-assembled from Home Depot and I treated the switch like I did with practically every other barbecue I’ve ever owned. In most other barbecues, the button rotates or pulls off to expose a battery bellow. I pulled and tugged on that cover to inspect the battery as I hard as I dared without breaking it. No luck. Then I crawled underneath and traced the wires to the other side of the barbecue, and found the battery under a screw down cover there. That’s different. I think Weber would do well to pit a little sticker next to the striker button to prevent newbies like me from doing damage on their brand new purchase. On other thing: who ever was painting the cover of this of this barbecue at the factory missed a spot. It was a small, out of the way area, which is probably why it was missed in manufacturing, but still annoying. I fixed it myself, though, with heat resistant enamel paint.
Results.Title: Continued Improvement, With Small Flaws

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I got this grill to replace a three year old Nexgrill from Home Depot. That grill, although it was larger and had more options, had completely disintegrated. I found I didn’t have occasion to use that extra stuff and decided that I should put more focus on quality over quantity. So far I so glad I did. The consistency of the heat and the feel of the grates is so much nicer. Things do cook differently, so I’m making some adjustments, but I’m super pleased with how things are turning out coming off the grill. I hope it holds up as well as my friends say their Webers have.
Results.Title: Really nice little grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago and the push button igniter does not work on a regular basis. The grill overall is terrific.
Results.Title: Florida grillin’

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago after hesitating spending the money on this 3-burner Weber Spirit, and I’m so glad I did. The grill is exactly what I need where I’m often cooking for 1 or 2. It’s hits 550-600 degrees in 7-8 minutes, and cooks very evenly for fish, steak, and chicken. Couldn’t be happier with the purchase.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber. Cooks our fresh caught beaver perfectly! Very even temp levels, the entire surface is a “hot spot”! Nothing beats a solid piece of meat off my Weber, especially after a night of plundering beaver.
Results.Title: Perfect grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought the grill last month and have been really surprised how good it is.  Easy start, great grille area and fast to heat up for grilling.  Easy to clean and a great size for all the grilling that we do.  Looked at various web sites for comparisons and reviews and glad we purchased this unit.
Results.Title: Really nice grille

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Wife got this for me as a birthday present. Replaced a bigger grill ( not Weber). With the foldable table I can store in the garage. Used it a bunch. Very even cooking and plenty of space for cooking. I didn't realize that I had no need for the big one this replaced. Clean up and maintenance super easy. You will save on the amount of propane you use due to its design. My tank is basically empty and we still able to grill on it 4 times :) plus a 10 warranty on everything. You can go wrong. Love the big wheels as well. I can roll it anyway. my old grill had small wheels and chewed up my grass when moving it. Not an issue with this grill.
Results.Title: Loving it :)

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I waited a few years in my new home to purchase a grill because I wanted a Weber. My mom surprised me with a trip to a Home Depot and and bought it for me for my 40 th. I like the compact size for 2 people... however we had a cook out and I was able to pile on a ton! Love the how easy it it to turn on/ off and how easy it is to move!! Best grill I ever had!!!
Results.Title: Love it!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I had a Spirit 3-burner grill for 10 years and it just wouldn't wear out so I gave it to my grand daughter and bought this new one. It is perfect for what we need. I especially like the open cabinet design.
Results.Title: Just What we Need

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought several weeks back. Easy to assemble and very well made. I’ve grilled several different things on it now and really can’t find a weak spot. Flare ups are basically non existent and no real hot spot to be found as with most all other grills I’ve owned. Easy to clean up as well. I’m very pleased so far and glad I bought this grill.
Results.Title: Best one yet.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Great grill, excellent quality workmanship.  It cleans easy, the IGrill options are a must, the probe temperature readings are spot on
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I got the grill 2 weeks ago love it no problem with wind
Results.Title: Love the grill needed 2 parts got them right away

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber gas grills for decades so purchasing their workhorse Spirit II E-310 gas grill was a no brainer, or so I thought.  The current version is a lot more plastic construction and the burner system does not get hot enough for a good meat sear.  I am dissapointed in the quality now being sold and I would not repurchase.
Results.Title: They Don't Make Them Like They Used To
